messages:
Tommy (Product Designer): Hey all  I'm Tommy, starting today on the product design team. Two quick things: 1) how do I join the Figma org and the shared Product UI Kit? 2) where do research briefs live and what's the expected level of detail for an initial discovery brief? cc @Renee

Renee (Design Lead): welcome Tommy! :tada: For Figma: use Okta -> Apps -> Request 'Figma (Redwood)'. If it stays pending after ~30 mins, ping @Chris. I'll also add you to the 'Product - Designers' team and the Product UI Kit manually.

Chris (Design Ops): Hi Tommy 44b FYI auto-approvals run on weekdays 9am-5pm local. If you requested outside that window it may show pending. If needed i'll do a manual invite. Figma team name is "Redwood - Product".

Aisha (PM): roadmap is in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.company/product/roadmap (shortlink in #product-onboarding). For research: we keep briefs in Drive -> design/research/playbooks. Typical starter brief is short: problem, target users, 1-2 assumptions, and one primary success metric. For larger efforts include timeline and stakeholders.

Tommy (Product Designer): thanks! Can you paste the brief template here so I can model my first one?

Renee (Design Lead): sure, here's the short template we ask for (paste into a new doc):

```
Title: one-liner
Problem statement: 2-3 sentences
Users: who we're designing for
Assumptions: 2-3 hypotheses
Primary metric: what success looks like
Proposed timeline: quick sketch of milestones
Stakeholders: who to loop in
```

Renee (Design Lead): Process note: post the brief to #design-research with tag "study-request" when you're ready. Design Ops will triage screener and recruitment. For quick prototype checks you can just share a Figma prototype + quick notes in the playbook.

Access Bot: Access request received: 'Figma' submitted by Tommy. Ticket #ACC-9003. Estimated processing: 1-3 hours.

Tommy (Product Designer): Tried Okta flow, shows pending. Chris, i'll DM you the ticket id. Also curious who runs the quarterly research roundup?

Chris (Design Ops): Manual approval done; invite sent to your work email. Quarterly roundup is run by Design Research (Renee + Aisha rotate ownership) 
 we collect syntheses in the Drive folder and post highlights in the product all-hands.

Tommy (Product Designer): got the Figma invite and Product UI Kit 60a Thanks! I'll draft a short brief for an early-nav experiment and drop it in #design-research later today.

Aisha (PM): great, happy to review the brief and sync after. Welcome aboard!"
